name: The Call of a Sea Girl
source:
Kehlani’s been struggling to find the will to go on after a life-changing event that's left her a shell of her former self. While everyone trudges day after day, her desire to keep going slips more and more.  Her place in the world has vanished.

Yet the sea beckons her.

Unintentionally answering its call, she finds much more than anticipated. The deep ocean's embrace is replaced by the arms of a bewitching sea girl.

[From [url=https://theedemigawd.itch.io/the-call-of-a-sea-girl]itch.io[/url]]
